data.descriptionInput: Investment Banking and Hedge Funds Operations

items.description: Graduates move into core finance operations roles with a career trajectory of ₹12 - 30 LPA within 3 - 5 years*, depending on role progression and performance.
The program is designed for fast employability, with an ROI horizon of ~6 - 12 months, based on role entry and individual outcomes.
Structured specifically for Investment Banking Operations, Hedge Fund Operations, Trade Support, and Risk roles, the execution and control functions that enable global financial markets.
Delivered through live, interactive sessions, including immersive modules across Investment Banking, Hedge Funds, Equity Research, and Risk-focused functions, ensuring learning goes beyond theory.
Curriculum is built around industry-backed case studies and real-life use cases, mapped directly to job responsibilities within global investment banks and hedge funds.
Develops operational expertise and strategic financial acumen valued by hiring companies, offering global exposure, stability across market cycles, and clear long-term progression paths.

data.title: Curriculum Overview
data.subtitle: The program curriculum is structured into four focused parts, designed to build core finance capability along with industry readiness for global finance roles.

description: Equities, fixed income, money markets, and derivatives
Trade lifecycle, settlement, corporate actions, and static data
Advanced operations, including forex, commodities, collateral management, and stock lending
Hedge fund strategies, products, and derivatives
Option strategies, Greeks, and swaps
NAV calculations, fund administration, reconciliation, and live trading exposure
Accounting, taxation, and private equity context
Income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow analysis
Valuation techniques including DCF, FCFF, and FCFE
Ratio analysis, advanced modelling concepts, and LBO case studies
Live case-based financial statement preparation
Personal branding, LinkedIn visibility, and professional communication
Resume building, ATS optimisation, and interview readiness
Mock interviews, stress interviews, and detailed performance feedback
Strength - weakness assessment and interview mastery frameworks

data.title: Why Choose Finance Forum of India (FFOI)?

items.descriptionInput: Finance Forum of India (FFOI) is a Section 8 Not-for-Profit organisation, established in 2000, operating with a public-interest mandate and aligned with national education and skill frameworks.

items.titleInput: Years of Legacy in Finance Education
items.descriptionInput: With 25+ years of experience, FFOI has trained 25,000+ learners and engaged 1,000+ institutions, building long-term finance capability rather than short-term certifications.
Through structured finance aptitude and skill assessments, FFOI helps learners identify domain fit, skill gaps, and realistic career paths.
FFOI works with students, professionals, universities, B-schools, corporates, and skill ecosystems to deliver outcome-oriented finance education.
Operates national membership networks, finance conclaves, and leadership forums, enabling professional networking and industry exposure.

data.title: Frequently Asked Questions
data.subtitle: Get answers to common questions about our program

items.questionInput: How is this different from an MBA in Finance?
items.answerInput: This is a short-term, NSQF-aligned certificate program focused on investment banking and hedge fund operations, not a degree program.

items.questionInput: Do I need prior coding or advanced mathematics knowledge?
items.answerInput: No. Skills are built progressively from fundamentals.

items.questionInput: What kind of careers can I pursue after this program?
items.answerInput: Investment Banking Operations, Hedge Fund Operations, Trade Support, Risk & Compliance, Collateral Operations.

items.questionInput: What is the placement potential and ROI of this program?
items.answerInput: Starting salaries: ₹8 - 15 LPA | Top roles: ₹40 - 80 LPA+ | ROI horizon: ~12 - 18 months.
Yes. Limited merit-based scholarships are available.

items.questionInput: Who is eligible to apply for this program?
items.answerInput: Graduates (10+2+3 / 10+2+4) from Commerce or Engineering with 60%+ marks. Final-year students may apply.
Placements are not guaranteed; outcomes depend on performance and market conditions.

items.questionInput: What industries and companies can I work with after completion?
items.answerInput: Global Investment Banks, Hedge Funds, Custodians, Asset Managers, FinTech, Financial Services firms.

items.questionInput: Is the program practical or only theory-based?
items.answerInput: It is highly practical, using real trade workflows, case studies, and operational simulations.

items.questionInput: How long is the program and what is the approval?
items.answerInput: 9-Week Certificate Program | NSQF Aligned | RT-MSSU Affiliated | NCVT Mapped.
